143def value_params(required, params, func): 

144 ''' 

145 Check that *params* holds every parameter that the value function *func* 

146 needs (see *tbkit.values*). 

147 

148 Raises 

149 ------ 

150 TypeError 

151 The value function needs parameters missing from get_ham. 

152 ''' 

153 missing = [name for name in required if name not in params] 

154 if missing: 

155 raise TypeError('\n\nThe value function {} needs the parameter(s) {}: ' 

156 'pass them to get_ham (or KSpace.set_params).\n'.format( 

157 getattr(func, '__name__', func), ', '.join(missing)))

160def value_shape(val, size, spin, func): 

161 ''' 

162 Check the values returned by the value function *func* for *size* 

163 bonds or sites: a number or one per entry (or, if *spin*, also a 2x2 

164 matrix or one per entry). 

165 

166 Raises 

167 ------ 

168 ValueError 

169 The value function must return a number or an array of one value per bond/site. 

170 ''' 

171 shapes = [(), (size,)] + ([(2, 2), (size, 2, 2)] if spin else []) 

172 if val.shape not in shapes: 

173 raise ValueError('\n\nThe value function {} returned shape {}: it must return a number, ' 

174 'or one per bond/site (shape ({},)){}.\n'.format( 

175 getattr(func, '__name__', func), val.shape, size, 

176 ', or a 2x2 matrix (one per bond, shape ({}, 2, 2))'.format(size) 

177 if spin else ''))

353def unit_cell(unit_cell): 

354 ''' 

355 Check parameter *unit_cell*. 

356 

357 Raises 

358 ------ 

359 TypeError 

360 Parameter unit_cell must be a list. 

361 KeyError 

362 Dictionaries must contain the key "tag". 

363 KeyError 

364 Dictionaries must contain the key "r0". 

365 TypeError 

366 Key "tags" must contain a one-character string. 

367 ValueError 

368 Key "tags" must contain a one-character string. 

369 ValueError 

370 Key "r0" must contain be a list. 

371 TypeError 

372 Key "r0" must contain be a tuple. 

373 ValueError 

374 Key "r0" must contain a tuple of length two. 

375 ValueError 

376 Key "r0" must contain a tuple of two real numbers. 

377 ''' 

378 if not isinstance(unit_cell, list): 

379 raise TypeError('\n\nParameter unit_cell must be a list.\n') 

380 for dic in unit_cell: 

381 if 'tag' not in dic: 

382 raise KeyError('\n\nDictionaries must contain the key "tag".\n') 

383 if 'r0' not in dic: 

384 raise KeyError('\n\nDictionaries must contain the key "r0".\n') 

385 if not isinstance(dic['tag'], str): 

386 raise TypeError('\n\nKey "tag" must contain a one-character string.\n') 

387 if not len(dic['tag']) == 1: 

388 raise ValueError('\n\nKey "tag" must be a one-character string.\n') 

389 if not isinstance(dic['r0'], tuple): 

390 raise TypeError('\n\nKey "r0" must be a tuple.\n') 

391 if len(dic['r0']) not in (2, 3): 

392 raise ValueError('\n\nKey "r0" must contain a tuple of length two (or three, ' 

393 'for a lattice in 3D space).\n') 

394 if not all(isinstance(c, (int, float)) for c in dic['r0']): 

395 raise ValueError('\n\nKey "r0" must contain a tuple of real numbers.\n') 

396 if len({len(dic['r0']) for dic in unit_cell}) > 1: 

397 raise ValueError('\n\nAll "r0" must have the same length.\n') 

398

400def prim_vec(prim_vec): 

401 ''' 

402 Check parameter *prim_vec*. 

403 

404 Raises 

405 ------ 

406 TypeError 

407 Parameter prim_vec must be a list. 

408 ValueError 

409 Parameter prim_vec must be a list 

410 of length 1 for 1D lattices or length 2 fro 2D lattices. 

411 TypeError 

412 List elements must be tuples. 

413 ValueError 

414 List elements must be 1 or 2 tuples. 

415 ValueError 

416 Tuples must be of length 2. 

417 ValueError 

418 Tuples must containt real numbers. 

419 ValueError 

420 Norm of coor should be larger than 0.1. 

421 ''' 

422 if not isinstance(prim_vec, list): 

423 raise TypeError('\n\nParameter prim_vec must be a list.\n') 

424 if len(prim_vec) not in (1, 2, 3): 

425 raise ValueError('\n\nParameter prim_vec must be a list of length 1 ' 

426 'for 1D lattices, 2 for 2D lattices, or 3 for 3D lattices.\n') 

427 for coor in prim_vec: 

428 if not isinstance(coor, tuple): 

429 raise TypeError('\n\nParameter prim_vec must contain tuples.\n') 

430 if len(coor) not in (2, 3): 

431 raise ValueError('\n\nParameter prim_vec must contain tuples of length 2 ' 

432 '(or 3, for a lattice in 3D space).\n') 

433 if not all(isinstance(c, (int, float)) for c in coor): 

434 raise ValueError('\n\nParameter prim_vec must contain tuples of ' 

435 'real numbers.\n') 

436 if sum(c ** 2 for c in coor) < 0.1: 

437 raise ValueError('\n\nEach primitive vector must have a norm larger ' 

438 'than 0.1.\n') 

439 if len({len(coor) for coor in prim_vec}) > 1: 

440 raise ValueError('\n\nAll primitive vectors must have the same length.\n') 

441 if len(prim_vec) > len(prim_vec[0]): 

442 raise ValueError('\n\nA lattice cannot have more primitive vectors than ' 

443 'space dimensions (use 3-tuples for a 3D lattice).\n') 

444

446def independent(prim_vec): 

447 ''' 

448 Check that the primitive vectors are linearly independent (needed for 

449 the reciprocal lattice). 

450 

451 Raises 

452 ------ 

453 ValueError 

454 The primitive vectors must be linearly independent. 

455 ''' 

456 if np.linalg.matrix_rank(np.array(prim_vec, dtype='f8'), tol=1e-8) != len(prim_vec): 

457 raise ValueError('\n\nThe primitive vectors must be linearly independent.\n')

475def get_lattice(prim_vec, n1, n2, n3=1): 

476 ''' 

477 Check method *get_lattice*.

481 TypeError

499def coor(coor, dtype=None): 

500 ''' 

501 Check if *coor* is a structured array with 

502 dtype=[('x', 'f8'), ('y', 'f8'), ('tag', 'U1')], or, for a lattice in 3D 

503 space, dtype=[('x', 'f8'), ('y', 'f8'), ('z', 'f8'), ('tag', 'U1')]. If 

504 *dtype* is given, *coor* must have exactly that dtype. 

505 ''' 

506 dtypes = [np.dtype([('x', 'f8'), ('y', 'f8'), ('tag', 'U1')]), 

507 np.dtype([('x', 'f8'), ('y', 'f8'), ('z', 'f8'), ('tag', 'U1')])] 

508 if dtype is not None: 

509 dtypes = [np.dtype(dtype)] 

510 if coor.dtype not in dtypes: 

511 raise TypeError('\n\nParameter coor dtype must be\n' 

512 'dtype=[("x", "f8"), ("y", "f8"), ("tag", "U1")]\n' 

513 '(with a ("z", "f8") field after "y" for a lattice in 3D space).\n') 

514

650def set_onsite(onsite, tags): 

651 ''' 

652 Check method *set_onsite*. 

653 

654 Raises 

655 ------ 

656 TypeError 

657 Parameter onsite must be a dictionary. 

658 ValueError 

659 Parameter onsite keys must be a tag. 

660 ValueError 

661 Parameter onsite values must be 

662 real and/or complex numbers, or value functions. 

663 ''' 

664 if not isinstance(onsite, dict): 

665 raise TypeError('\n\nParameter onsite must be a dictionary.\n') 

666 for tag, val in onsite.items(): 

667 if tag not in tags: 

668 raise ValueError('\n\nParameter onsite keys must be a tag.\n') 

669 if not isinstance(val, (int, float, complex)) and not callable(val): 

670 raise ValueError('\n\nParameter onsite values must be\n'\ 

671 'real and/or complex numbers, or value functions.\n')

674def set_hopping(list_hop, n_max): 

675 ''' 

676 Check method *set_hopping*. 

677 

678 Raises 

679 ------ 

680 TypeError 

681 Parameter *list_hop* must be a list. 

682 TypeError 

683 Parameter *list_hop* must be a list of dictionary. 

684 KeyError 

685 "n" and "t" must be dictionary keys. 

686 KeyError 

687 "tag" or "ang" must be a key. 

688 KeyError 

689 "tag" and "ang" must be keys. 

690 ValueError 

691 Dictionaries must be of length 2, 3, or 4. 

692 ValueError 

693 "n" must be between 1 and nmax" 

694 ''' 

695 if not isinstance(list_hop, list): 

696 raise TypeError('\n\nParameter *list_hop* must be a list.\n') 

697 for dic in list_hop: 

698 if not isinstance(dic, dict): 

699 raise TypeError('\n\nParameter *list_hop* must be a list of dictionary.\n') 

700 if 'n' not in dic or 't' not in dic: 

701 raise KeyError('\n\n"n" and "t" must be dictionary keys.\n') 

702 if not isinstance(dic['n'], int): 

703 raise TypeError('\n\n"n" value must be an integer.\n') 

704 if not 0 < dic['n'] <= n_max: 

705 raise ValueError('\n\n"n" value must be between 1 and {}.\n'.format(n_max)) 

706 if not isinstance(dic['t'], (int, float, complex)) and not callable(dic['t']): 

707 raise TypeError('\n\n"t" value must be a real or complex number, or a value function.\n') 

708 if len(dic) == 3: 

709 if 'tag' not in dic and 'ang' not in dic: 

710 raise KeyError('\n\n"tag" or "ang" must be a key.\n') 

711 elif len(dic) == 4: 

712 if 'tag' not in dic or 'ang' not in dic: 

713 raise KeyError('\n\n"tag" and "ang" must be keys.\n') 

714 elif len(dic) > 4: 

715 raise ValueError('\n\nDictionaries must be of length 2, 3, or 4.\n') 

716 if 'tag' in dic: 

717 if not isinstance(dic['tag'], str): 

718 raise TypeError('\n\n"tag" value must be a string.\n') 

719 if len(dic['tag']) != 2: 

720 raise ValueError('\n\n"tag" value must be a string of length 2.\n') 

721 if 'ang' in dic: 

722 if not isinstance(dic['ang'], (int, float)): 

723 raise TypeError('\n\n"ang" value must be a real number.\n') 

724

734def set_hopping_def(hop, hopping_def, sites, var_name='hopping_def', same_site=False): 

735 ''' 

736 Check methods *set_hopping_def* and *set_hopping_manual*. 

737 

738 *hop* is not used (kept for backward compatibility). Indices may be 

739 Python or NumPy integers, values Python or NumPy numbers. If *same_site* 

740 is True, keys :math:`(i, i)` are accepted. 

741 

742 Raises 

743 ------ 

744 TypeError 

745 Parameter *hopping_def* must be a dictionary 

746 TypeError 

747 *hopping_def* keys must be tuples. 

748 TypeError 

749 *hopping_def* keys must be tuples of length 2. 

750 ValueError 

751 *hopping_def* keys must be tuples of integers. 

752 ValueError 

753 *hopping_def* keys must be integers between 0 and sites-1. 

754 ValueError 

755 *hopping_def* keys must be different integers between 0 and sites-1. 

756 TypeError 

757 *hopping_def* values must be numbers. 

758 ''' 

759 if not isinstance(hopping_def, dict): 

760 raise TypeError('\n\nParameter {} must be a dictionary.\n'.format(var_name)) 

761 for key, val in hopping_def.items(): 

762 if not isinstance(key, tuple): 

763 raise TypeError('\n\n{} keys must be tuples.\n'.format(var_name)) 

764 if len(key) != 2: 

765 raise TypeError('\n\n{} keys must be tuples of length 2.\n'.format(var_name)) 

766 if not isinstance(key[0], (int, np.integer)) or not isinstance(key[1], (int, np.integer)): 

767 raise ValueError('\n\n{} keys must be tuples of integers.\n'.format(var_name)) 

768 if key[0] < 0 or key[1] < 0 or key[0] > sites-1 or key[1] > sites-1: 

769 raise ValueError('\n\n{} keys must be integers between 0 and sites-1.\n'.format(var_name)) 

770 if key[0] == key[1] and not same_site: 

771 raise ValueError('\n\n{} keys must be different integers between 0 and sites-1.\n'.format(var_name)) 

772 if not isinstance(val, (int, float, complex, np.number)): 

773 raise TypeError('\n\n{} values must be numbers.\n'.format(var_name)) 

774 

775 

776def set_onsite_def(onsite_def, sites): 

777 ''' 

778 Check method *set_ons_def*. 

779 

780 Raises

782 TypeError 

783 Parameter *onsite_def* must be a dictionary. 

784 TypeError 

785 *onsite_def* keys must be integers. 

786 TypeError 

787 *onsite_def* values must be numbers. 

788 ValueError 

789 *onsite_def* keys must be integers between :math:`[0, sites)`. 

790 ''' 

791 if not isinstance(onsite_def, dict):

793 for key, val in onsite_def.items():

795 raise TypeError('\n\nonsite_def keys must be integers.\n') 

796 if not isinstance(val, (int, float, complex)): 

797 raise TypeError('\n\nonsite_def values must be numbers.\n') 

798 if key < 0 or key > sites-1: 

799 raise ValueError('\n\nonsite_def keys must be integers between 0 and sites-1.\n')

1121def k_vector(vec, var_name, ndim): 

1122 ''' 

1123 Check that *vec* is a tuple/list of *ndim* real numbers. 

1124 

1125 Raises 

1126 ------ 

1127 TypeError 

1128 Parameter *var_name* must be a tuple/list. 

1129 ValueError 

1130 Parameter *var_name* must be of length *ndim*. 

1131 TypeError 

1132 Parameter *var_name* must contain real numbers. 

1133 ''' 

1134 if not isinstance(vec, (tuple, list, np.ndarray)): 

1135 raise TypeError('\n\nParameter {} must be a tuple, list, or ndarray.\n'.format(var_name)) 

1136 if len(vec) != ndim: 

1137 raise ValueError('\n\nParameter {} must be of length {}.\n'.format(var_name, ndim)) 

1138 for val in vec: 

1139 if not isinstance(val, (int, float, np.integer, np.floating)): 

1140 raise TypeError('\n\nParameter {} must contain real numbers.\n'.format(var_name)) 

1141 

1142 

1143def k_points(k, var_name, ndim): 

1144 ''' 

1145 Check that *k* is one k-point (see *k_vector*) or an array of shape 

1146 (nk, *ndim*) of real numbers. 

1147 

1148 Raises 

1149 ------ 

1150 ValueError 

1151 Parameter *var_name* must be of shape (nk, ndim). 

1152 ''' 

1153 if np.ndim(k) != 2: 

1154 k_vector(k, var_name, ndim) 

1155 return 

1156 k = np.asarray(k) 

1157 if k.shape[1] != ndim or not np.issubdtype(k.dtype, np.number) or np.iscomplexobj(k): 

1158 raise ValueError('\n\nParameter {} must be a real array of shape (nk, {}).\n'.format(var_name, ndim)) 

1159 

1160

1165 

1166 Raises 

1167 ------ 

1168 ValueError 

1169 Parameter ks must be of shape (nk, ndim). 

1170 ''' 

1171 if ks.ndim != 2 or ks.shape[1] != ndim: 

1172 raise ValueError('\n\nParameter ks must be an array of shape (nk, {}).\n'.format(ndim))

1175def spin_matrix(t, var_name): 

1176 ''' 

1177 Check a spinful "t" or onsite value: either a plain number, or a 2x2 

1178 complex matrix. 

1179 

1180 Raises 

1181 ------ 

1182 TypeError 

1183 Parameter *var_name* must be a number or a 2x2 matrix. 

1184 ''' 

1185 if isinstance(t, (int, float, complex)): 

1186 return 

1187 t = np.asarray(t) 

1188 if t.shape != (2, 2): 

1189 raise TypeError('\n\nParameter {} must be a number or a 2x2 matrix.\n'.format(var_name))

1191 

1192def set_hopping_kspace(list_hop, n_sites, ndim, spin=False, values=False): 

1193 ''' 

1194 Check method *kspace.set_hopping*. With *values*, "t" may also be a 

1195 value function (a callable). 

1196 

1197 Raises 

1198 ------ 

1199 TypeError 

1200 Parameter *list_hop* must be a list of dictionaries. 

1201 KeyError 

1202 "i", "j", "R", and "t" must be dictionary keys. 

1203 ValueError 

1204 "i" and "j" must be site indices between 0 and n_sites-1. 

1205 ValueError 

1206 "R" must be a tuple of *ndim* integers. 

1207 TypeError 

1208 "t" must be a real or complex number (or, if *spin*, 

1209 a 2x2 matrix). 

1210 ''' 

1211 if not isinstance(list_hop, list): 

1212 raise TypeError('\n\nParameter list_hop must be a list.\n') 

1213 for dic in list_hop: 

1214 if not isinstance(dic, dict): 

1215 raise TypeError('\n\nParameter list_hop must be a list of dictionaries.\n') 

1216 if not {'i', 'j', 'R', 't'} <= set(dic): 

1217 raise KeyError('\n\n"i", "j", "R", and "t" must be dictionary keys.\n') 

1218 if not isinstance(dic['i'], int) or not isinstance(dic['j'], int): 

1219 raise TypeError('\n\n"i" and "j" must be integers.\n') 

1220 if not (0 <= dic['i'] < n_sites) or not (0 <= dic['j'] < n_sites): 

1221 raise ValueError('\n\n"i" and "j" must be site indices between 0 and {}.\n'.format(n_sites-1)) 

1222 if not isinstance(dic['R'], tuple) or len(dic['R']) != ndim: 

1223 raise ValueError('\n\n"R" must be a tuple of {} integers.\n'.format(ndim)) 

1224 if not all(isinstance(n, int) for n in dic['R']): 

1225 raise TypeError('\n\n"R" must be a tuple of integers.\n') 

1226 if dic['i'] == dic['j'] and dic['R'] == (0,) * ndim: 

1227 raise ValueError('\n\nUse kspace.set_onsite for i == j and R == 0 ' 

1228 '(it accepts a 2x2 spin matrix when spin=True).\n') 

1229 if values and callable(dic['t']): 

1230 continue 

1231 if spin: 

1232 spin_matrix(dic['t'], '"t"') 

1233 elif not isinstance(dic['t'], (int, float, complex)): 

1234 raise TypeError('\n\n"t" value must be a real or complex number.\n') 

1235 

1236 

1237def set_onsite_kspace(dict_onsite, tags, spin=False): 

1238 ''' 

1239 Check method *kspace.set_onsite*. 

1240 

1241 Raises 

1242 ------ 

1243 TypeError 

1244 Parameter *dict_onsite* must be a dictionary. 

1245 ValueError 

1246 keys must be tags. 

1247 TypeError 

1248 values must be real or complex numbers (or, if 

1249 *spin*, a pair of real/complex numbers, or a 2x2 matrix). 

1250 ''' 

1251 if not isinstance(dict_onsite, dict): 

1252 raise TypeError('\n\nParameter dict_onsite must be a dictionary.\n') 

1253 for tag, val in dict_onsite.items(): 

1254 if tag not in tags: 

1255 raise ValueError('\n\nParameter dict_onsite keys must be a tag.\n') 

1256 if spin and not isinstance(val, (int, float, complex)): 

1257 is_pair = (isinstance(val, (tuple, list)) and len(val) == 2 

1258 and all(isinstance(v, (int, float, complex)) for v in val)) 

1259 is_mat = np.ndim(val) == 2 and np.shape(val) == (2, 2) 

1260 if not (is_pair or is_mat): 

1261 raise TypeError('\n\nParameter dict_onsite values must be a number, or, ' 

1262 'if spin, a pair of numbers (E_up, E_down) or a ' 

1263 '2x2 matrix.\n') 

1264 elif not spin and not isinstance(val, (int, float, complex)): 

1265 raise TypeError('\n\nParameter dict_onsite values must be real and/or complex numbers.\n') 

1266 

1267 

1268def k_path_points(points, ndim): 

1269 ''' 

1270 Check parameter *points* used by *kspace.k_path*. 

1271

1273 ------ 

1274 TypeError 

1275 Parameter points must be a list. 

1276 ValueError 

1277 Parameter points must contain at least two k-points. 

1278 ''' 

1279 if not isinstance(points, list): 

1280 raise TypeError('\n\nParameter points must be a list of k-points.\n') 

1281 if len(points) < 2: 

1282 raise ValueError('\n\nParameter points must contain at least two k-points.\n') 

1283 for i, pt in enumerate(points): 

1284 k_vector(pt, 'points[{}]'.format(i), ndim)

1347 ------ 

1348 ValueError 

1349 Parameter *var_name* must be a 1D array of at least two increasing real values. 

1350 ''' 

1351 grid = np.asarray(grid) 

1352 if grid.ndim != 1 or len(grid) < 2 or np.iscomplexobj(grid) or np.any(np.diff(grid) <= 0): 

1353 raise ValueError('\n\nParameter {} must be a 1D array of at least two increasing ' 

1354 'real values.\n'.format(var_name))

1357def nk(nk, ndim): 

1358 ''' 

1359 Check parameter *nk* used by *kspace.mesh_bands* / *kspace.berry_curvature*. 

1360 

1361 Raises 

1362 ------ 

1363 TypeError 

1364 Parameter nk must be an integer or a tuple of integers. 

1365 ValueError 

1366 Parameter nk (or each of its elements) must be a 

1367 positive integer. 

1368 ValueError 

1369 Parameter nk must be a tuple of length *ndim*. 

1370 ''' 

1371 if isinstance(nk, int): 

1372 positive_int(nk, 'nk') 

1373 return 

1374 if not isinstance(nk, tuple): 

1375 raise TypeError('\n\nParameter nk must be an integer or a tuple of integers.\n') 

1376 if len(nk) != ndim: 

1377 raise ValueError('\n\nParameter nk must be of length {}.\n'.format(ndim)) 

1378 for n in nk: 

1379 positive_int(n, 'nk')

1422 ------

1445 ValueError

1544def parities(xi, tol=1e-6): 

1545 ''' 

1546 Check that inversion eigenvalues are +-1. 

1547 

1548 Raises 

1549 ------ 

1550 ValueError 

1551 The bands are not an inversion-invariant subspace. 

1552 ''' 

1553 if not np.allclose(np.abs(xi.real), 1., atol=tol) or not np.allclose(xi.imag, 0., atol=tol): 

1554 raise ValueError('\n\nThe parity eigenvalues are not +-1: the operator is not ' 

1555 'an inversion symmetry of these bands (or the bands are ' 

1556 'degenerate with the others at a TRIM).\n') 

1557 if np.sum(xi.real < 0) % 2: 

1558 raise ValueError('\n\nOdd number of negative parities: the bands are not ' 

1559 'Kramers pairs.\n')

1575def is_symmetry(err, tol):

1577 Check that a symmetry error is below *tol*.

1579 Raises 

1580 ------ 

1581 ValueError 

1582 The operator is not a symmetry of the model.

1589def symmetry_algebra(u, v, tol): 

1590 ''' 

1591 Check that two symmetry operators of the same kind agree up to a phase 

1592 (in *kspace.KSpace.non_hermitian_class*, *v* is a product of others). 

1593 

1594 Raises 

1595 ------ 

1596 ValueError 

1597 The symmetry operators leave a unitary symmetry: block-diagonalize it first. 

1598 ''' 

1599 phase = np.trace(u.conj().T @ v) / np.trace(u.conj().T @ u) 

1600 if not np.allclose(v, phase * u, atol=tol): 

1601 raise ValueError('\n\nThe symmetry operators leave a unitary symmetry (two products of ' 

1602 'the same kind differ by more than a phase): block-diagonalize ' 

1603 'the Hamiltonian first.\n') 

1604 

1605 

1606def square(sq, tol): 

1607 ''' 

1608 Check that the square of an antiunitary operator is +-1. 

1609 

1610 Raises 

1611 ------ 

1612 ValueError 

1613 The square of the operator must be +1 or -1. 

1614 ''' 

1615 if not np.allclose(sq, sq[0, 0] * np.eye(len(sq)), atol=tol) or \ 

1616 not np.isclose(abs(sq[0, 0]), 1., atol=tol): 

1617 raise ValueError('\n\nThe square of the antiunitary operator must be +1 or -1.\n') 

1618

1623 

1624 Raises 

1625 ------ 

1626 ValueError 

1627 This calculation requires a Hermitian Hamiltonian. 

1628 ''' 

1629 if (abs(ham - ham.conj().T) > 1e-12).nnz: 

1630 raise ValueError('\n\nThis calculation requires a Hermitian Hamiltonian.\n')

1744def loop(loop): 

1745 ''' 

1746 Check a closed loop of *tbkit.exceptional*: a callable of s in [0, 1] 

1747 returning a point of the plane, or the vertices of a polygon. 

1748 

1749 Raises 

1750 ------ 

1751 TypeError 

1752 Parameter loop must be a callable or an array of vertices. 

1753 ValueError 

1754 A polygon needs at least 3 vertices with 2 real coordinates. 

1755 ''' 

1756 if callable(loop): 

1757 return 

1758 try: 

1759 arr = np.asarray(loop, dtype='f8') 

1760 except (TypeError, ValueError): 

1761 arr = np.zeros(()) 

1762 if arr.ndim == 0: 

1763 raise TypeError('\n\nParameter loop must be a callable of s in [0, 1], or an ' 

1764 'array of polygon vertices.\n') 

1765 if arr.ndim != 2 or arr.shape[0] < 3 or arr.shape[1] != 2 or not np.all(np.isfinite(arr)): 

1766 raise ValueError('\n\nParameter loop must hold at least 3 vertices of 2 real ' 

1767 'coordinates, shape (m, 2).\n') 

1768 

1769

1771 ''' 

1772 Check a point returned by a loop callable: 2 finite real numbers. 

1773 

1774 Raises 

1775 ------ 

1776 ValueError 

1777 The loop must return points of 2 real coordinates. 

1778 ''' 

1779 if point.shape != (2,) or not np.all(np.isfinite(point)): 

1780 raise ValueError('\n\nParameter loop must return points of 2 finite real ' 

1781 'coordinates.\n')

1784def closed_loop(ham_start, ham_end): 

1785 ''' 

1786 Check that a loop is closed: the Hamiltonian at its end is the one at its start. 

1787 

1788 Raises 

1789 ------ 

1790 ValueError 

1791 The loop is not closed. 

1792 ''' 

1793 scale = max(1., float(np.max(np.abs(ham_start)))) 

1794 if np.max(np.abs(ham_end - ham_start)) > 1e-9 * scale: 

1795 raise ValueError('\n\nParameter loop must be closed: H(loop(1)) differs from ' 

1796 'H(loop(0)).\n') 

1797

1876def gap_kind(gap):

1889def biorthogonal_kind(kind): 

1890 ''' 

1891 Check the kind of Berry connection: 'LR', 'RL', 'RR' or 'LL'. 

1892 

1893 Raises 

1894 ------ 

1895 ValueError 

1896 Parameter kind must be "LR", "RL", "RR" or "LL". 

1897 '''

1902def line_gap(keys, bands, gap): 

1903 ''' 

1904 Check that *bands* are separated from the other bands by a line gap: 

1905 with the bands ordered by *keys* (Re E or Im E, shape (nk, norb)) at 

1906 every k-point, a band inside the group and its neighbour outside it 

1907 never overlap over the whole mesh. 

1908 

1909 Raises 

1910 ------ 

1911 ValueError 

1912 The bands have no line gap. 

1913 ''' 

1914 inside = np.zeros(keys.shape[1], bool) 

1915 inside[bands] = True 

1916 for n in range(keys.shape[1] - 1): 

1917 if inside[n] != inside[n + 1] and np.max(keys[:, n]) >= np.min(keys[:, n + 1]): 

1918 part = 'Re E' if gap == 'real' else 'Im E' 

1919 raise ValueError('\n\nThe bands {} are not separated from the others by a {} line ' 

1920 'gap: sorted by {}, band {} reaches band {} over the ' 

1921 'Brillouin zone, so the band labels are not continuous. ' 

1922 'For a non-Hermitian model, use ' 

1923 'KSpace.biorthogonal_chern_number with the other kind of ' 

1924 'gap, or locate the gap-closing exceptional points with ' 

1925 'tbkit.exceptional.find_exceptional_points.\n' 

1926 .format(bands, gap, part, n, n + 1)) 

1927 

1928 

1929def band_continuity(en, bands): 

1930 ''' 

1931 Check that a group of bands, labelled at every point of a periodic k 

1932 mesh (*en*, complex, shape (n1, n2, norb)), is continuous: matching the 

1933 eigenvalues of neighbouring points by distance maps the group onto 

1934 itself. A line gap measured on the mesh alone can miss a narrow 

1935 crossing between mesh points; this catches the jump of the labels. 

1936 

1937 Raises 

1938 ------ 

1939 ValueError 

1940 The band labels jump between neighbouring k-points. 

1941 ''' 

1942 from scipy.optimize import linear_sum_assignment 

1943 inside = np.zeros(en.shape[2], bool) 

1944 inside[bands] = True 

1945 for axis in (0, 1): 

1946 nxt = np.roll(en, -1, axis=axis) 

1947 for e_a, e_b in zip(en.reshape(-1, en.shape[2]), nxt.reshape(-1, en.shape[2])): 

1948 _, perm = linear_sum_assignment(np.abs(e_a[:, None] - e_b[None, :])) 

1949 if np.any(inside != inside[perm]): 

1950 raise ValueError('\n\nThe bands {} are not separated from the others over the ' 

1951 'Brillouin zone: between neighbouring k-points they ' 

1952 'exchange eigenvalues with the other bands (the line gap ' 

1953 'closes, e.g. at exceptional points, or nk is too small). ' 

1954 'For a non-Hermitian model, try ' 

1955 'KSpace.biorthogonal_chern_number with the other kind of ' 

1956 'gap, or tbkit.exceptional.find_exceptional_points.\n' 

1957 .format(bands)) 

1958

2004def n_eig(n_eig, sites): 

2005 ''' 

2006 Check the number of eigenpairs of *system.get_eig_sparse*. 

2007 

2008 Raises 

2009 ------ 

2010 TypeError 

2011 Parameter n_eig must be an integer. 

2012 ValueError 

2013 Parameter n_eig must be between 1 and sites-2. 

2014 ''' 

2015 positive_int(n_eig, 'n_eig') 

2016 if n_eig > sites - 2: 

2017 raise ValueError('\n\nParameter n_eig must be between 1 and {} (use get_eig for ' 

2018 'the full spectrum).\n'.format(sites - 2))

2234def conservation_law(law, h0, v, tol=1e-10): 

2235 ''' 

2236 Check the conservation law of a lead: a Hermitian matrix of the shape 

2237 of *h0* that commutes with *h0* and *v*. 

2238 

2239 Raises 

2240 ------ 

2241 ValueError 

2242 Wrong shape, not Hermitian, or not conserved by the lead. 

2243 ''' 

2244 if law.shape != h0.shape: 

2245 raise ValueError('\n\nParameter conservation_law must have the shape of h0, {}.\n'.format(h0.shape)) 

2246 hermitian_operator(law, tol) 

2247 scale = max(1., np.max(np.abs(h0)), np.max(np.abs(v))) 

2248 if max(np.max(np.abs(law @ h0 - h0 @ law)), np.max(np.abs(law @ v - v @ law))) > tol * scale: 

2249 raise ValueError('\n\nThe conservation law must commute with the lead\'s h0 and v.\n') 

2250 

2251 

2252def lead_block(lead, n_blocks): 

2253 ''' 

2254 Check a lead of a scattering matrix: a lead index, or a tuple 

2255 (lead, block) with a block of that lead's conservation law. 

2256 

2257 Raises 

2258 ------ 

2259 TypeError 

2260 Not an integer or a tuple of two integers. 

2261 ValueError 

2262 No such lead or block. 

2263 ''' 

2264 if isinstance(lead, tuple): 

2265 if len(lead) != 2 or not all(isinstance(x, (int, np.integer)) for x in lead): 

2266 raise TypeError('\n\nA lead block must be a tuple (lead, block) of two integers.\n') 

2267 lead_index(int(lead[0]), len(n_blocks)) 

2268 if not 0 <= lead[1] < n_blocks[lead[0]]: 

2269 raise ValueError('\n\nLead {} has {} block(s) (its conservation law).\n'.format( 

2270 lead[0], n_blocks[lead[0]])) 

2271 else: 

2272 lead_index(lead, len(n_blocks))

2325def max_order(list_hop): 

2326 ''' 

2327 Largest neighbour order 'n' requested by a (possibly malformed) list of 

2328 hoppings; 1 if there is none (the list is validated afterwards). 

2329 ''' 

2330 try: 

2331 orders = [dic['n'] for dic in list_hop if isinstance(dic['n'], int)] 

2332 except (TypeError, KeyError): 

2333 return 1 

2334 return max([n for n in orders if n > 0] + [1])

2342def orbitals(orbs): 

2343 ''' 

2344 Check a list of orbital names. 

2345 

2346 Raises 

2347 ------ 

2348 TypeError 

2349 The orbitals must be a list of names. 

2350 ValueError 

2351 Unknown or repeated orbital. 

2352 ''' 

2353 from tbkit.slater_koster import ORBITALS 

2354 if not isinstance(orbs, list) or not orbs:

2359 if len(set(orbs)) != len(orbs):

2363def orbital_dict(orbital_dict, tags):

2365 Check the orbitals of *OrbitalSystem*: a list of orbitals for every tag. 

2366

2368 ------ 

2369 TypeError

2372 Every tag needs its orbitals. 

2373 ''' 

2374 if not isinstance(orbital_dict, dict): 

2375 raise TypeError('\n\nParameter orbitals must be a dictionary {tag: list of orbitals}.\n') 

2376 for tag in tags:

2379 for orbs in orbital_dict.values():

2383def sk_params(params): 

2384 ''' 

2385 Check a dictionary of Slater-Koster bond integrals. 

2386 

2387 Raises 

2388 ------ 

2389 TypeError 

2390 Parameter params must be a dictionary of numbers. 

2391 ValueError 

2392 Unknown bond integral. 

2393 ''' 

2394 from tbkit.slater_koster import PARAMS 

2395 if not isinstance(params, dict): 

2396 raise TypeError('\n\nThe bond integrals must be a dictionary.\n') 

2397 for key, val in params.items(): 

2398 if key not in PARAMS: 

2399 raise ValueError('\n\nUnknown bond integral {!r}: use {}.\n'.format(key, PARAMS)) 

2400 if not isinstance(val, (int, float)): 

2401 raise TypeError('\n\nBond integral {!r} must be a real number.\n'.format(key)) 

2402 

2403 

2404def sk_pair_params(params, tags_i, tags_j): 

2405 ''' 

2406 Check the bond integrals of *set_slater_koster*: one dictionary, or one 

2407 per tag pair of the bonds. 

2408 

2409 Returns 

2410 ------- 

2411 bool 

2412 True if keyed by tag pair. 

2413 

2414 Raises 

2415 ------ 

2416 ValueError 

2417 A tag pair of the bonds has no bond integrals. 

2418 ''' 

2419 from tbkit.slater_koster import PARAMS 

2420 if not isinstance(params, dict): 

2421 raise TypeError('\n\nThe bond integrals must be a dictionary.\n') 

2422 by_pair = bool(params) and all(k not in PARAMS for k in params) 

2423 if not by_pair: 

2424 sk_params(params) 

2425 return False 

2426 for a, b in set(zip(tags_i, tags_j)): 

2427 if a + b not in params: 

2428 raise ValueError('\n\nNo bond integrals for the tag pair {!r}.\n'.format(a + b)) 

2429 sk_params(params[a + b]) 

2430 return True

2638def pairing(delta, n): 

2639 ''' 

2640 Check a BdG pairing matrix: (n, n), antisymmetric. 

2641 

2642 Raises 

2643 ------ 

2644 ValueError 

2645 The pairing matrix must be (n, n) and antisymmetric. 

2646 ''' 

2647 if delta.shape != (n, n): 

2648 raise ValueError('\n\nThe pairing matrix must have the shape ({0}, {0}) of ham.\n'.format(n)) 

2649 if (abs(delta + delta.T) > 1e-12).nnz: 

2650 raise ValueError('\n\nThe pairing matrix must be antisymmetric (Delta^T = -Delta).\n')

2666def pairing_kspace(pairing, norb, ndim): 

2667 ''' 

2668 Check the pairings of *bdg.bdg_kspace*. 

2669 

2670 Raises 

2671 ------ 

2672 TypeError 

2673 Parameter pairing must be a list of dictionaries. 

2674 KeyError 

2675 "i", "j", "R" and "delta" must be keys. 

2676 ValueError 

2677 Orbital indices below norb; R a tuple of ndim integers. 

2678 ''' 

2679 if not isinstance(pairing, list): 

2680 raise TypeError('\n\nParameter pairing must be a list of dictionaries.\n') 

2681 for dic in pairing: 

2682 if not isinstance(dic, dict): 

2683 raise TypeError('\n\nParameter pairing must be a list of dictionaries.\n') 

2684 if not {'i', 'j', 'R', 'delta'} <= set(dic): 

2685 raise KeyError('\n\n"i", "j", "R" and "delta" must be dictionary keys.\n') 

2686 if not all(isinstance(dic[k], int) and 0 <= dic[k] < norb for k in ('i', 'j')): 

2687 raise ValueError('\n\n"i" and "j" must be orbital indices between 0 and {}.\n'.format(norb - 1)) 

2688 if not isinstance(dic['R'], tuple) or len(dic['R']) != ndim or \ 

2689 not all(isinstance(n, int) for n in dic['R']): 

2690 raise ValueError('\n\n"R" must be a tuple of {} integers.\n'.format(ndim)) 

2691 number(dic['delta'], '"delta"')

2879def path_values(values): 

2880 ''' 

2881 Check the parameter values of a path: a 1D array of at least two finite 

2882 real numbers, strictly increasing or strictly decreasing.

2885 ------

2895 if len(arr) < 2 or not np.all(np.isfinite(arr)) or not (np.all(step > 0) or np.all(step < 0)):

2897 'strictly increasing or strictly decreasing.\n')

2983def step_models(models, kspace_cls, system_cls): 

2984 ''' 

2985 Check the models of a step drive: a non-empty list, either of KSpace 

2986 instances (Hermitian, orthogonal basis, one lattice size) or of System 

2987 instances and square matrices. Returns 'kspace' or 'matrix'. 

2988 

2989 Raises 

2990 ------ 

2991 TypeError 

2992 Parameter models must be a non-empty list of KSpace, System or matrices. 

2993 ValueError 

2994 The KSpace models must be Hermitian, with no overlap, of one size. 

2995 ''' 

2996 if not isinstance(models, (list, tuple)) or len(models) == 0: 

2997 raise TypeError('\n\nParameter models must be a non-empty list of KSpace instances, ' 

2998 'or of System instances and matrices.\n') 

2999 if all(isinstance(m, kspace_cls) for m in models): 

3000 for m in models: 

3001 if (m.norb, m.dim) != (models[0].norb, models[0].dim): 

3002 raise ValueError('\n\nThe KSpace models must have the same orbitals and dimension.\n') 

3003 if not m.is_hermitian(): 

3004 raise ValueError('\n\nThe KSpace models must be Hermitian.\n') 

3005 if m._overlap_hop: 

3006 raise ValueError('\n\nThe KSpace models need an orthogonal basis (no overlap).\n') 

3007 return 'kspace' 

3008 for m in models: 

3009 if not isinstance(m, system_cls) and getattr(m, 'ndim', None) != 2: 

3010 raise TypeError('\n\nParameter models must be a list of KSpace instances only, ' 

3011 'or of System instances and square matrices.\n') 

3012 return 'matrix' 

3013

3015def step_matrices(hams): 

3016 ''' 

3017 Check the Hamiltonians of a real-space step drive: Hermitian square 

3018 matrices of one shape. 

3019 

3020 Raises 

3021 ------ 

3022 TypeError 

3023 Parameter hams must be a non-empty list of matrices. 

3024 ValueError 

3025 The matrices must be square, Hermitian and of one shape. 

3026 ''' 

3027 if not isinstance(hams, (list, tuple)) or len(hams) == 0: 

3028 raise TypeError('\n\nParameter hams must be a non-empty list of matrices.\n') 

3029 shape = np.shape(hams[0]) 

3030 for h in hams: 

3031 h = np.asarray(h) 

3032 if h.ndim != 2 or h.shape[0] != h.shape[1] or h.shape != shape: 

3033 raise ValueError('\n\nThe step Hamiltonians must be square matrices of one shape.\n') 

3034 hermitian_dense(h)

3082#################################### 

3083# MODEL BUILDING, BRIDGES AND I/O 

3084# (neighbour-order hoppings in k-space, System <-> KSpace, tbkit.io) 

3085#################################### 

3086 

3087 

3088def hopping_form(list_hop): 

3089 ''' 

3090 Tell the two forms of *KSpace.set_hopping* apart: the explicit one 

3091 (keys 'i', 'j', 'R', 't') and the neighbour-order one of 

3092 *System.set_hopping* (keys 'n', 't', and optionally 'ang', 'tag'). 

3093 

3094 Returns 

3095 ------- 

3096 neighbour : Boolean 

3097 True for the neighbour-order form. 

3098 

3099 Raises 

3100 ------ 

3101 TypeError 

3102 Parameter list_hop must be a list of dictionaries. 

3103 ValueError 

3104 list_hop mixes the two forms. 

3105 ''' 

3106 if not isinstance(list_hop, list): 

3107 raise TypeError('\n\nParameter list_hop must be a list.\n') 

3108 if not all(isinstance(dic, dict) for dic in list_hop): 

3109 raise TypeError('\n\nParameter list_hop must be a list of dictionaries.\n') 

3110 by_order = ['n' in dic for dic in list_hop] 

3111 if any(by_order) and not all(by_order): 

3112 raise ValueError('\n\nParameter list_hop mixes explicit hoppings (keys "i", "j", "R", "t") ' 

3113 'and neighbour-order ones (keys "n", "t", "ang", "tag"): ' 

3114 'make one call per form.\n') 

3115 return bool(list_hop) and all(by_order) 

3116 

3117 

3118def set_hopping_neighbours(list_hop, spin=False): 

3119 ''' 

3120 Check the neighbour-order form of *KSpace.set_hopping*. 

3121 

3122 Raises 

3123 ------ 

3124 KeyError 

3125 "n" and "t" must be keys, and only "ang" and "tag" may be added. 

3126 TypeError 

3127 "n" must be an integer, "t" a number (or, if *spin*, 

3128 a 2x2 matrix) or a value function, "ang" a real number and "tag" a string. 

3129 ValueError 

3130 "n" must be positive, "ang" in [-180, 180), "tag" of length 2. 

3131 ''' 

3132 hopping_form(list_hop) 

3133 for dic in list_hop: 

3134 if 'n' not in dic or 't' not in dic: 

3135 raise KeyError('\n\n"n" and "t" must be dictionary keys.\n') 

3136 if not set(dic) <= {'n', 't', 'ang', 'tag'}: 

3137 raise KeyError('\n\nOnly the keys "n", "t", "ang" and "tag" are allowed.\n') 

3138 if isinstance(dic['n'], bool) or not isinstance(dic['n'], int): 

3139 raise TypeError('\n\n"n" value must be an integer.\n') 

3140 if dic['n'] < 1: 

3141 raise ValueError('\n\n"n" value must be a positive integer.\n') 

3142 if callable(dic['t']): 

3143 pass 

3144 elif spin: 

3145 spin_matrix(dic['t'], '"t"') 

3146 elif not isinstance(dic['t'], (int, float, complex)): 

3147 raise TypeError('\n\n"t" value must be a real or complex number.\n') 

3148 if 'ang' in dic: 

3149 if not isinstance(dic['ang'], (int, float)): 

3150 raise TypeError('\n\n"ang" value must be a real number.\n') 

3151 if not -180. <= dic['ang'] < 180.: 

3152 raise ValueError('\n\n"ang" value must be in [-180, 180).\n') 

3153 if 'tag' in dic: 

3154 if not isinstance(dic['tag'], str): 

3155 raise TypeError('\n\n"tag" value must be a string.\n') 

3156 if len(dic['tag']) != 2: 

3157 raise ValueError('\n\n"tag" value must be a string of length 2.\n') 

3158 

3159 

3160def shell_angle(ang, angles): 

3161 ''' 

3162 Check that a neighbour shell has bonds along the angle *ang* (in 

3163 degrees, either orientation: *angles* are those in [0, 180)). 

3164 

3165 Raises 

3166 ------ 

3167 ValueError 

3168 No bond of the shell points along *ang*. 

3169 ''' 

3170 if not np.any(np.isclose(ang, angles, atol=ATOL)) and \ 

3171 not np.any(np.isclose(ang, angles - 180., atol=ATOL)): 

3172 raise ValueError('\n\nNo bond of this neighbour shell has angle {} (angles: {}).\n' 

3173 .format(ang, np.unique(angles.round(4))))

3190def lattice_sites(matches): 

3191 ''' 

3192 Check that every site of a finite lattice is a copy of exactly one 

3193 orbital of *unit_cell*, translated by a lattice vector (*matches*: the 

3194 number of such orbitals, per site). 

3195 

3196 Raises 

3197 ------ 

3198 ValueError 

3199 A site is not on the periodic lattice. 

3200 ''' 

3201 bad = np.flatnonzero(np.asarray(matches) != 1) 

3202 if len(bad): 

3203 raise ValueError('\n\nSite {} is not a translate of exactly one unit-cell site (same tag, ' 

3204 'position r0 + n1 a1 + ...): was the lattice rotated, strained ' 

3205 'or shifted?\n'.format(int(bad[0])))

3214 ------ 

3215 ValueError 

3216 The model is not translation invariant. 

3217 ''' 

3218 if dev > tol: 

3219 raise ValueError('\n\nThe Hamiltonian is not translation invariant: equivalent hoppings ' 

3220 'or onsite energies differ by {:.3g} (> tol = {:.3g}), e.g. after '

3224def torus_range(R, sizes): 

3225 ''' 

3226 Check that the lattice vectors of a torus's bonds (shortest images, in

3231 ------ 

3232 ValueError 

3233 The torus is too small for the range of the model.

3235 if np.any(sizes < 3) or np.any(2 * R == -sizes[None, :]): 

3236 raise ValueError('\n\nThe torus ({} cells) is too small for the range of the model: ' 

3237 'a bond reaches half-way around it.\n'.format(tuple(int(n) for n in sizes)))

3284def hr_header(tokens): 

3285 ''' 

3286 Check the header of a Wannier90 ``_hr.dat`` file: num_wann, nrpts and 

3287 the nrpts degeneracy weights, as positive integers. 

3288 

3289 Raises 

3290 ------ 

3291 ValueError 

3292 Not a Wannier90 _hr.dat file. 

3293 ''' 

3294 try: 

3295 num_wann, nrpts = int(tokens[0]), int(tokens[1]) 

3296 weights = [int(w) for w in tokens[2:2 + nrpts]] 

3297 except (IndexError, ValueError): 

3298 raise ValueError('\n\nNot a Wannier90 _hr.dat file: expected num_wann, nrpts and ' 

3299 'the degeneracy weights after the header line.\n') from None 

3300 if num_wann < 1 or nrpts < 1 or len(weights) != nrpts or min(weights) < 1: 

3301 raise ValueError('\n\nNot a Wannier90 _hr.dat file: num_wann, nrpts and the ' 

3302 'degeneracy weights must be positive integers.\n') 

3303 

3304 

3305def hr_body(n_tokens, nrpts, num_wann): 

3306 ''' 

3307 Check the number of entries of a Wannier90 ``_hr.dat`` file. 

3308 

3309 Raises 

3310 ------ 

3311 ValueError 

3312 The file must have nrpts * num_wann**2 lines of 7 numbers. 

3313 ''' 

3314 if n_tokens != 7 * nrpts * num_wann ** 2:

3494def wannier_gap(nu, sector, tol=1e-4): 

3495 ''' 

3496 Check that a Wannier sector is separated from the other Wannier bands 

3497 over the mesh (*nu*, shape (n1, n2, nb), sorted at each k): at every k, 

3498 the smallest distance on the circle between a Wannier band of the 

3499 sector and one outside it (the Wannier gap) exceeds *tol*, and the 

3500 Wannier bands of the sector change between neighbouring k-points by 

3501 less than the smallest gap (otherwise two Wannier bands crossed between 

3502 them, or the sector wrapped around the circle). 

3503 

3504 Raises 

3505 ------ 

3506 ValueError 

3507 The Wannier sector is not separated by a Wannier gap. 

3508 ''' 

3509 nu = np.asarray(nu) 

3510 rest = [n for n in range(nu.shape[-1]) if n not in sector] 

3511 if not rest: 

3512 return 

3513 

3514 def circ(d): 

3515 d = np.abs(d) % 1. 

3516 return np.minimum(d, 1. - d) 

3517 gap = np.min(circ(nu[..., sector][..., :, None] - nu[..., rest][..., None, :])) 

3518 jump = max(np.max(circ(nu[..., sector] - np.roll(nu[..., sector], 1, axis=a))) 

3519 for a in range(nu.ndim - 1)) 

3520 if gap < tol or jump >= gap: 

3521 raise ValueError('\n\nThe Wannier sector is not separated from the other Wannier ' 

3522 'bands by a Wannier gap (smallest distance {:.2e}, largest ' 

3523 'step {:.2e}).\n'.format(gap, jump)) 

3524

3834def hermitian_operator(ops, tol=1e-10): 

3835 ''' 

3836 Check that an operator (shape (..., norb, norb)) is Hermitian. 

3837 

3838 Raises 

3839 ------ 

3840 ValueError 

3841 The operator must be Hermitian. 

3842 ''' 

3843 if np.max(np.abs(ops - ops.conj().swapaxes(-1, -2))) > tol: 

3844 raise ValueError('\n\nThe operator must be Hermitian.\n') 

3845 

3846 

3847def projected_gap(w, tol=1e-6): 

3848 ''' 

3849 Check that the projected operator POP (eigenvalues *w*, shape (nk, n), 

3850 sorted) has no eigenvalue near zero, and the same number of negative 

3851 eigenvalues at every k-point; return that number. 

3852 

3853 Raises 

3854 ------ 

3855 ValueError 

3856 The spectrum of POP must have a gap around zero. 

3857 ''' 

3858 n_minus = np.sum(w < 0., axis=1) 

3859 if np.min(np.abs(w)) < tol or np.any(n_minus != n_minus[0]): 

3860 raise ValueError('\n\nThe spectrum of the projected operator POP closes around zero ' 

3861 '(smallest |eigenvalue| {:.3g}): the two sectors are not ' 

3862 'defined.\n'.format(float(np.min(np.abs(w))))) 

3863 return int(n_minus[0]) 

3864 

3865 

3866def mirror_square(squares, tol): 

3867 ''' 

3868 Check that a mirror operator squares to +1 or -1 (*squares*, shape 

3869 (..., norb, norb)); return the sign. 

3870 

3871 Raises 

3872 ------ 

3873 ValueError 

3874 The mirror operator must square to +1 or -1. 

3875 ''' 

3876 sign = np.sign(squares[0, 0, 0].real) 

3877 eye = np.eye(squares.shape[-1]) 

3878 if sign == 0 or np.max(np.abs(squares - sign * eye)) > tol: 

3879 raise ValueError('\n\nThe mirror operator must be unitary and square to +1 or -1.\n') 

3880 return int(sign)

3965 ------ 

3966 ValueError 

3967 The matrix must be antisymmetric. 

3968 ''' 

3969 if np.max(np.abs(a + a.T), initial=0.) > tol: 

3970 raise ValueError('\n\nThe matrix must be antisymmetric.\n') 

3971

3982 if norb % 2:

3990 time-reversal-invariant momentum is real (particle-hole symmetry).

4021def periodic(periodic, dim): 

4022 ''' 

4023 Check parameter *periodic* of *System*: a boolean, or a tuple of *dim* 

4024 booleans (one per primitive vector); return the tuple. 

4025 

4026 Raises 

4027 ------ 

4028 TypeError 

4029 Parameter periodic must be a bool or a tuple of bools. 

4030 ValueError 

4031 Parameter periodic must have one entry per primitive vector. 

4032 ''' 

4033 if isinstance(periodic, bool): 

4034 return (periodic,) * dim 

4035 if not isinstance(periodic, tuple) or not all(isinstance(p, bool) for p in periodic): 

4036 raise TypeError('\n\nParameter periodic must be a bool or a tuple of bools.\n') 

4037 if len(periodic) != dim: 

4038 raise ValueError('\n\nParameter periodic must have one entry per primitive vector ' 

4039 '({}).\n'.format(dim)) 

4040 return periodic

4046 

4047 Raises 

4048 ------ 

4049 ValueError 

4050 Periodic boundaries need lat.get_lattice first. 

4051 ''' 

4052 if n1 == 0: 

4053 raise ValueError('\n\nPeriodic boundaries wrap the n1 x n2 (x n3) cells of ' 

4054 'lat.get_lattice: call it first.\n')

4056 

4057def torus_size(dist, period, n): 

4058 ''' 

4059 Check that bonds of length *dist* (order *n*) reach less than half-way 

4060 around the torus (shortest period *period*), so that each one has a 

4061 single shortest image. 

4062 

4063 Raises 

4064 ------ 

4065 ValueError 

4066 The torus is too small for this neighbour order. 

4067 ''' 

4068 if 2 * dist >= period - ATOL: 

4069 raise ValueError('\n\nThe torus is too small for the neighbours of order {}: their ' 

4070 'length {:.3f} reaches half-way around it (shortest period ' 

4071 '{:.3f}). Use more cells.\n'.format(n, dist, period)) 

4072 

4073 

4074def not_periodic(periodic, method):

4079 ------ 

4080 ValueError 

4081 The method needs open boundaries. 

4082 ''' 

4083 if any(periodic): 

4084 raise ValueError('\n\n{} needs open boundaries (periodic=False); on a torus, see ' 

4085 'System.get_bott_index and set_peierls_phase.\n'.format(method))

4088def torus_2d(periodic):

4090 Check that a System is a 2D torus (periodic along two primitive vectors).

4094 ValueError

4099 'along both primitive vectors (periodic=True).\n')

4107def projector(proj, norb, tags): 

4108 ''' 

4109 Check parameter *projector* of *kspace.band_weights*: an orbital index, 

4110 a non-empty list of distinct orbital indices, a sublattice tag, or a 

4111 (norb, norb) Hermitian matrix. 

4112 

4113 Raises 

4114 ------ 

4115 TypeError 

4116 Parameter projector must be an orbital index, a list of them, a tag or a matrix. 

4117 ValueError 

4118 Orbital indices must be distinct and between 0 and norb-1. 

4119 ValueError 

4120 Parameter projector must be a tag of the unit cell. 

4121 ValueError 

4122 The operator must be a (norb, norb) Hermitian matrix. 

4123 ''' 

4124 if isinstance(proj, str): 

4125 if proj not in tags: 

4126 raise ValueError('\n\nParameter projector must be a tag of the unit cell: ' 

4127 '{}.\n'.format(sorted(set(tags)))) 

4128 return 

4129 if isinstance(proj, np.ndarray) and proj.ndim == 2: 

4130 operator(proj, norb) 

4131 hermitian_operator(proj) 

4132 return 

4133 if isinstance(proj, int): 

4134 proj = [proj] 

4135 if not isinstance(proj, list) or not proj or not all(isinstance(p, int) for p in proj): 

4136 raise TypeError('\n\nParameter projector must be an orbital index, a list of ' 

4137 'orbital indices, a sublattice tag or a (norb, norb) matrix.\n') 

4138 if len(set(proj)) != len(proj) or not all(0 <= p < norb for p in proj): 

4139 raise ValueError('\n\nOrbital indices must be distinct and between 0 and ' 

4140 '{}.\n'.format(norb - 1))

4152 '''

4155 raise ValueError('\n\nParameter weights must be a finite real array of shape {}, ' 

4156 'the shape of the bands (see band_weights).\n'.format(shape))

4186def cubic_path(points, names, axes): 

4187 ''' 

4188 Check the parameters of *kspace.cubic_path*. 

4189 

4190 Raises 

4191 ------ 

4192 TypeError 

4193 Parameter points must be a dictionary. 

4194 ValueError 

4195 Each point must have 3 real coordinates. 

4196 ValueError 

4197 Parameter names must list at least two keys of points. 

4198 ValueError 

4199 Parameter axes must be 3 orthonormal rows. 

4200 ''' 

4201 if not isinstance(points, dict): 

4202 raise TypeError('\n\nParameter points must be a dictionary (label: point).\n') 

4203 for key, point in points.items(): 

4204 point = np.asarray(point) 

4205 if point.shape != (3,) or not np.isrealobj(point) or not np.all(np.isfinite(point)): 

4206 raise ValueError('\n\nPoint {} must have 3 real coordinates.\n'.format(key)) 

4207 if (not isinstance(names, (list, tuple)) or len(names) < 2 

4208 or any(n not in points for n in names)): 

4209 raise ValueError('\n\nParameter names must list at least two keys of points.\n') 

4210 if axes is not None: 

4211 axes = np.asarray(axes) 

4212 if axes.shape != (3, 3) or not np.isrealobj(axes) or not np.allclose(axes @ axes.T, np.eye(3)): 

4213 raise ValueError('\n\nParameter axes must be 3 orthonormal rows (shape (3, 3)).\n')

4226 raise ValueError('\n\nNo standard high-symmetry path for this {}D lattice: ' 

4227 'high_symmetry_path knows the 1D and 2D Bravais lattices, ' 

4228 'and the simple cubic, fcc, bcc, simple tetragonal and ' 

4229 'hexagonal ones in 3D. Pass the k-points to k_path ' 

4230 'directly.\n'.format(dim))

4294def continuum_symbols(names): 

4295 ''' 

4296 Check the free symbols of the Hamiltonian of *continuum.discretize*: 

4297 no position (the model is translation invariant), no symbol named 

4298 like the grid spacing *a*, and parameter names that can be passed as 

4299 keyword arguments. 

4300 

4301 Raises 

4302 ------ 

4303 ValueError 

4304 x, y, z are not supported. 

4305 ValueError 

4306 a is reserved for the grid spacing. 

4307 ValueError 

4308 Parameter names must be Python identifiers. 

4309 ''' 

4310 position = sorted(names & {'x', 'y', 'z'}) 

4311 if position: 

4312 raise ValueError('\n\nThe Hamiltonian depends on the position ({}): only translation-' 

4313 'invariant continuum models (constant coefficients) can be ' 

4314 'discretized into a KSpace.\n'.format(', '.join(position))) 

4315 if 'a' in names: 

4316 raise ValueError('\n\nThe symbol a is reserved for the grid spacing: rename the ' 

4317 'parameter.\n') 

4318 bad = sorted(n for n in names if not n.isidentifier() or n in ('site_i', 'site_j')) 

4319 if bad: 

4320 raise ValueError('\n\nParameter names must be Python identifiers (other than site_i, ' 

4321 'site_j), to be passed to get_ham: {}.\n'.format(', '.join(bad)))

4328 

4329 Raises 

4330 ------

4333 ValueError

4340 if dim not in (1, 2, 3): 

4341 raise ValueError('\n\nParameter dim must be 1, 2 or 3.\n') 

4342 if used and max(used) >= dim: 

4343 raise ValueError('\n\nThe Hamiltonian uses {} in dimension {}.\n'.format( 

4344 ('k_x', 'k_y', 'k_z')[max(used)], dim))

4404#################################### 

4405# WANNIER FUNCTIONS 

4406#################################### 

4407 

4408 

4409def trial_orbitals(trial, norb, n_bands): 

4410 ''' 

4411 Check the trial orbitals of *wannier.wannierize*: a list of orbital 

4412 indices, or an array of shape (norb, n_wann), with at most *n_bands* 

4413 trial orbitals (one per Wannier function; fewer than the bands 

4414 disentangles them). 

4415 

4416 Raises 

4417 ------ 

4418 TypeError 

4419 Parameter trial must be a list of orbital indices or an array. 

4420 ValueError 

4421 Parameter trial must hold between 1 and n_bands trial orbitals. 

4422 ''' 

4423 if isinstance(trial, list) and trial and all(isinstance(o, int) for o in trial): 

4424 if len(trial) > n_bands or not all(0 <= o < norb for o in trial): 

4425 raise ValueError('\n\nParameter trial must hold at most {} orbital indices (one per ' 

4426 'Wannier function, at most one per band) between 0 and {}.\n' 

4427 .format(n_bands, norb - 1)) 

4428 return 

4429 try: 

4430 g = np.asarray(trial, dtype='c16') 

4431 except (TypeError, ValueError): 

4432 raise TypeError('\n\nParameter trial must be a list of orbital indices or a complex ' 

4433 'array of shape (norb, n_wann).\n') from None 

4434 if g.ndim != 2 or g.shape[0] != norb or not 1 <= g.shape[1] <= n_bands: 

4435 raise ValueError('\n\nParameter trial must be an array of shape ({}, n_wann), with ' 

4436 '1 <= n_wann <= {}: one column (trial orbital) per Wannier ' 

4437 'function, at most one per band.\n'.format(norb, n_bands)) 

4438 

4439 

4440def energy_window(window, var_name): 

4441 ''' 

4442 Check an energy window of *wannier.wannierize*: a tuple of two 

4443 increasing real numbers. 

4444 

4445 Raises 

4446 ------ 

4447 TypeError 

4448 Parameter var_name must be a tuple of two real numbers. 

4449 ValueError 

4450 Parameter var_name must be increasing. 

4451 ''' 

4452 if not isinstance(window, tuple) or len(window) != 2 or \ 

4453 not all(isinstance(e, (int, float)) and not isinstance(e, bool) for e in window): 

4454 raise TypeError('\n\nParameter {} must be a tuple (E_min, E_max) of two real ' 

4455 'numbers.\n'.format(var_name)) 

4456 if window[0] >= window[1]: 

4457 raise ValueError('\n\nParameter {} must satisfy E_min < E_max.\n'.format(var_name)) 

4458 

4459 

4460def frozen_window(frozen, window): 

4461 ''' 

4462 Check that the frozen (inner) window of *wannier.wannierize* lies 

4463 inside the outer window. 

4464 

4465 Raises 

4466 ------ 

4467 ValueError 

4468 The frozen window must lie inside the outer window. 

4469 ''' 

4470 if frozen[0] < window[0] or frozen[1] > window[1]: 

4471 raise ValueError('\n\nParameter frozen {} must lie inside the outer window {}.\n' 

4472 .format(frozen, window)) 

4473 

4474 

4475def window_states(n_inside, n_frozen, n_wann): 

4476 ''' 

4477 Check the number of states of the disentanglement windows at every 

4478 k-point: at least *n_wann* in the outer window, at most *n_wann* in the 

4479 frozen window. 

4480 

4481 Raises 

4482 ------ 

4483 ValueError 

4484 The outer window holds fewer than n_wann states at some k-point. 

4485 ValueError 

4486 The frozen window holds more than n_wann states at some k-point. 

4487 ''' 

4488 if n_inside < n_wann: 

4489 raise ValueError('\n\nThe outer window holds only {} of the bands at some k-point, ' 

4490 'fewer than the {} Wannier functions: widen it, or add bands.\n' 

4491 .format(n_inside, n_wann)) 

4492 if n_frozen > n_wann: 

4493 raise ValueError('\n\nThe frozen window holds {} bands at some k-point, more than the ' 

4494 '{} Wannier functions: narrow it.\n'.format(n_frozen, n_wann)) 

4495 

4496 

4497def isolated_bands(en, bands, tol=1e-8): 

4498 ''' 

4499 Check that a group of bands is separated in energy from the other bands 

4500 at every point of the mesh (*en*, shape (nk, norb), sorted). 

4501 

4502 Raises 

4503 ------ 

4504 ValueError 

4505 The bands are not isolated. 

4506 ''' 

4507 inside = np.zeros(en.shape[1], bool) 

4508 inside[bands] = True 

4509 for n in range(en.shape[1] - 1): 

4510 if inside[n] != inside[n + 1] and np.min(en[:, n + 1] - en[:, n]) < tol: 

4511 raise ValueError('\n\nThe bands {} touch band {} on the k-mesh: Wannier functions ' 

4512 'need an isolated group of bands: add the bands they touch to the group, ' 

4513 'or disentangle them (more bands than trial orbitals).\n' 

4514 .format(bands, n + 1 if inside[n] else n)) 

4515 

4516 

4517def projection(s_min, tol=1e-10): 

4518 ''' 

4519 Check that the projection of the bands onto the trial orbitals has full 

4520 rank at every k-point. 

4521 

4522 Raises 

4523 ------ 

4524 ValueError 

4525 The trial orbitals miss the bands at some k-point. 

4526 ''' 

4527 if s_min < tol: 

4528 raise ValueError('\n\nThe trial orbitals have no overlap with the bands at some ' 

4529 'k-point (singular projection): choose other trial orbitals, or ' 

4530 'another mesh. A band group with a nonzero Chern number has no ' 

4531 'localized Wannier functions, and any projection vanishes ' 

4532 'somewhere.\n')
